releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7.2
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7.2 ## New - **ZeroFG frame generation:** (experimental) adds frames between the ones a game draws, x2, x3 or x4, up to your display's refresh rate. It's in Settings > Performance and in the in-game menu. Switch it on before starting a game, switched on during one, it starts after Apply & Restart. By @hy300leosquizz-ctrl (#331).

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.4 beta
releases.body:
## Graphics and memory

**Faster frame submission.** MoltenVK now turns each frame into Metal work on its own thread instead of on the graphics thread, so the graphics thread spends almost no time submitting a frame. Framebuffers are now freed only after the GPU has finished with them, which this needed. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Freed textures give their memory back.** Large texture allocations now get memory of their own, which goes back to iOS when the texture is freed. Before, one texture still in use kept a whole 64 MB block, and One Piece held 2.3 GB of blocks for 643 MB of textures. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Upload buffer space comes back sooner.** The texture upload buffer gives back finished space after every full GPU wait, where it held it until the next frame and swapped in a new buffer instead.

**No stall on the first new shader.** The shader compiler's one-time setup now happens at boot. It used to land in gameplay, on the first shader a game hadn't shown before. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Black Ops II weapon.** The weapon in your hands no longer draws with its triangles over each other.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7.1
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7.1 ## Games - **Uncharted 2: Among Thieves, Super Street Fighter IV, Journey, and other games:** fixed the stop with "Failed to compile fragment shader" at the default Shader Precision (Low). - **Ratchet & Clank: Tools of Destruction:** fixed the freeze on Cobalia (thanks Seeslo for testing). -**Uncharted 3: Drake’s Deception** gets The Last of Us fix for freezes during play, since both games run the same job system, prevents freezes in UC3. ## Save states - **Save states from 1.7 and earlier don't load in 1.7.1,** because RPCS3's font module update changed the save state format. In-game saves are not affected.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7 ## Highlights - **New SPU code compiles in the background.** Games keep running while it compiles, so new areas load without pausing. Games that need the old pause keep it. - **Compiled SPU code now carries over between updates,** including game updates, so first boots after them are quick. Each game compiles once more on its first boot after this update. ## The Last of Us - **Fixed the freeze during play.** The game hands its work to background jobs and waits for them, and on phones a job list could stop with work still in it, freezing the game anywhere from minutes to hours in. ARMSX3 now keeps those jobs moving.

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.3 beta
releases.body:
## XMB mode

**The PS3's own menu.** ARMSX3 can now look and work like the PS3's XMB: the wave and sparkles, the boot, every column with its rows and settings, music with the Waves, Valley and Gaia visualizers, a video player, a photo viewer with slideshows, the XMB keyboard, and the in-game XMB with save states, Change Disc and Turn Off System. The icons, words, font and sounds come from your installed firmware, and a PS3 theme brings its own. Turn it on with the wave button in the library bar or in the last step of setup. On an iPhone it holds the screen in landscape, and while a game runs it lets go of its wave to leave the game more memory.

**Built-in Track and Turned off.** The Music column plays a built-in track, and Diagnostics lists a session you ended with Turn Off System as Turned off, where it said Closed by iOS.

## Black Ops III

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.8
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.8 brings the Apple II to phones and tablets, turns the touch screen into the Commander X16's mouse and the NES Zapper, and fixes the picture being cut off on phones with a gesture bar.

## What's new

- **The Apple II on a phone or tablet.** Hold it upright for a keyboard: Android's own, with rows of Esc, Tab, Ctrl, the arrows and Delete above it, plus Open Apple and Closed Apple, which stay down while you touch them. Reset only presses once you've held it for half a second, so a stray tap won't reset the machine. Turn it sideways for a joystick: an analog stick that moves as far as you push it, and buttons 0 and 1. Move it, resize it or hide it from the pause menu, as with the other pads.
- **The touch screen is the X16's mouse.** Drag a finger on the picture to move the pointer, tap to click, tap with two fingers to right-click, and tap then hold to drag. It works in the app and in the browser, so mouse programs like the Veranda desktop work on a phone.
- **Tap to shoot with the Zapper.** In Zapper games like Duck Hunt, tap the picture where you want to shoot.

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.7
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.7 brings the Commander X16 to phones and tablets, with a keyboard in portrait and a SNES pad in landscape, gives the X16 all its function keys and proper SNES controllers everywhere, and tidies up Android.

## What's new

- **The X16 on a phone or tablet.** Hold it upright for a keyboard: Android's own, with autocorrect and suggestions off, and rows of Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, the arrows, Home/End, Page Up/Down and Delete/Insert above it. Ctrl and Alt are sticky, so Ctrl then C sends Ctrl+C; tap twice to hold them. Fn brings up F1 to F12. Turn it sideways for a SNES pad.
- **Hide controls.** The pause menu on a touch screen can hide the on-screen controls for the rest of the game, and show them again.
- **The X16's F-keys are its own.** On the X16, and on the other computers that use the whole keyboard (Skink and BASIC), F1 to F12 go to the machine, so programs like busterm get them all. Open Bus's own keys move behind Ctrl+Shift: Ctrl+Shift+F1 opens the menu, Ctrl+Shift+F2 saves a state, and so on.

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.6
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.6 lets you install the web version as an app that opens without the internet, and fixes a way to get stuck in a game on Android phones.

## What's new

- **Install the web version as an app.** At https://obus.tuxprint.com/, Chrome and Edge offer to install Open Bus with its own window and icon, and Settings → Library has an Install button where your browser supports it. On iPhone, use Share → Add to Home Screen.
- **The web version works offline.** Once it's been opened, it opens again with no internet connection. It still picks up updates whenever you're online.
- **Your games stay put in the browser.** When you first add a game, the page asks the browser not to clear your games when it runs low on space.

## Fixed

- **Stuck in the emulator's menu on an Android phone.** Pressing Select and Start together on the on-screen controls opened a menu the on-screen buttons couldn't work, so the only way out was to quit the game. On-screen Select and Start now go to the game. A gamepad's Select and Start still open the menu, and Back still pauses.

| ---------------------- | --------------------------- |

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.5
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.5 makes the Android app work on phones and tablets, with on-screen controls for NES games, and keeps the Commander X16's clock on time.

## What's new

- **On-screen controls for NES games** on a phone or tablet with no gamepad: a D-pad, A and B, Select and Start. They hide when a gamepad connects and come back when it disconnects.
- **Move controls.** Drag each piece where you want it, make them bigger or smaller, turn the vibration off, or put B higher than A. Your layout is kept.
- **A pause menu for touch screens.** Back opens it: Resume, Save state, Load state, Reset, Move controls and Quit. Before this, there was no way out of a game on a phone without a gamepad.
- **The library on phones** stays clear of the status bar, navigation bar, camera cutout and on-screen keyboard. Games are always fullscreen.
- **The sidebar with a gamepad.** On a phone, opening the sidebar moves the gamepad's selection into it.

## Fixed

- **A TV remote's OK** stopped choosing in the menus if you bound A to something else, and didn't work in the X16's menu at all. It now always works in the menus, whatever the controls are set to.

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.4
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.4 gives the Commander X16's shelf its two standing tiles, and fixes busterm going missing or greyed out.

## What's new

- **The X16's shelf starts with the X16 and busterm.** Commander X16 (BASIC) is always the first tile and busterm the second, each with its own cover, whatever order the shelf is sorted in.
- **busterm in your own folders is left alone.** Open Bus keeps its own copy of busterm and keeps it up to date. A busterm in one of your folders shows as a game of its own, and Open Bus never writes to it.
- **Hide or remove a game from its details.** A game's details window now has Hide (for a game in one of your folders) or Remove (for the library's own copy), so a gamepad or TV remote can do it too.

## Fixed

- **busterm greyed out after removing and downloading it again**, saying its file wasn't found.
- **busterm missing from the X16 shelf after an update** until Open Bus was restarted.

This QA build targets startup hangs on the AYN Thor and Retroid Pocket 5.

# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 6

This QA build targets an intermittent early-boot hang reported on the Retroid Pocket 5.

The failed QA 5 diagnostic showed a live audio thread but no first presentation, native pipeline creation, scene target, or crash. The guest render thread stopped immediately after its first offscreen 2D captures.

QA 6 tightens the boot capture boundary:

- Only the four verified 2D vertex layouts and three supported primitive types are accepted.
- Individual and per-frame 2D payloads have conservative size limits.
- Invalid transient draw state is rejected before reading guest memory.
- The first twelve guest frames now log capture begin and completion markers.

Install QA 6 over the previous QA app, keep the System Driver selected, fully close the app between attempts, and test at least five launches. Attach diagnostics from any failed launch.

releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 5

This is an opt-in diagnostic build that installs over earlier **Skate 3 QA** builds and preserves QA app data.

## RP5 intermittent black-screen fix

QA 4 proved that the Retroid Pocket 5 can render the Quality profile's 1280x720 scene target, but testers reported that startup only succeeded roughly half the time.

The QA 4 profile copied Performance's visible feature settings, but one internal pipeline gate still used the profile number. Quality therefore compiled optional outline, spline, and shadow shader families even though those features were disabled. Cold and partially warmed shader caches could take different startup paths.

QA 5 fixes the mismatch:

- The 1280x720 Quality target remains enabled.
- The pipeline builder now follows the active lean-scene flag instead of assuming every Quality profile needs the full optional PSO set.
- Renderer installation applies the same defensive lean-feature guard.
- The startup log must report `lean Android set` for this QA Quality profile.
- Stable v2.0.17 and its update channel remain unchanged.

## RP5 test

1. Install QA 5 directly over QA 4.
2. Keep the System Driver selected.

Test build for issue #1422: with "Reuse compiled shaders from disk" on, the loading screen stood still at 100%. The game was waiting for the shader cache to be written to disk without redrawing the screen. The screen now counts those writes, and Esc or Circle ends the wait.

How to help:
- Extract the zip to a new folder
- From your current SpartanPort folder (the one with SpartanPort.exe), copy the `user` folder and the files `settings.json` and `spartanport.ini` into the new `spartanport-windows` folder, so the game starts from the same shader cache
- Open SpartanPort.exe in the new folder, keep "Reuse compiled shaders from disk" on and start the game
- After the count reaches the end it starts again for the cache writes, then "Preparing pipelines" runs for a few minutes
- Tell us on issue #1422:
  - Whether the count keeps moving and the game opens
  - Whether a second start goes straight into the game
  - Attach `user/last_run.log` from the new folder

Built on a development PC from commit c91ad6f, because GitHub Actions is off for the repository at the moment. Not a final release.

# Arceus Recomp for Android — v1.0 

Android port of **PokeL-ARecomp**, the static recompilation of *Pokémon Legends: Arceus*. Tested on the AYN Odin 3 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830).

- **Vulkan on Adreno**, with support for the **Turnip** (Mesa) driver, which you can import and pick from the menu.
- **"Soft" anti-aliasing** (new, default): blends the dithered pattern on hair, leaves and grass at no fps cost. SMAA is also available.

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения
- 🌟 **Шрифт интерфейса и стабильность настроек**: Выбор шрифта обновляет весь интерфейс Qt целиком при многократном переключении без перезапуска; устранено обрезание кнопок в шапке настроек и исправлен вылет при повторном открытии диалога настроек (Use-After-Free в коллбэке `ConfigureDialog`).
- 🌟 **Окно STORM GAMES WORLD**: Диалог автоматически центрируется относительно главного окна эмулятора с ровными отступами по 100px сверху, снизу, слева и справа (`width - 200px`, `height - 200px`).
- 🌟 **Живое переключение 3X (6K) без зависаний**: Переработан синхронный сброс и перестройка текстур/пайплайнов на GPU-потоке (`ApplyPendingResolutionChange`, `RequestResolutionUpdate`), устраняющие фриз при смене масштаба во время игры.
- 🌟 **Графика, стабильность и ядро**: Обновлены профили глубины `NEEDS_D24` для серии Xenoblade (`XC1 DE`, `XC3`), уточнён `ConvertBorderColor` для сэмплеров карт теней, добавлена безопасная очистка буферов и улучшен обработчик `STx_mult_2` в NCE.

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения
- 🌟 **Diablo III: Eternal Collection и модальные апплеты**: Устранено зависание ядра на 43.47 с и блокировка закрытия окна (`WM_CLOSE`) из-за модального окна выбора контроллера.
- 🌟 **Мгновенное завершение эмуляции (Xenoblade Chronicles 3 и др.)**: Устранены многосекундные задержки `CloseServices` (`hid`, `arp:r`, `psc:c`) - время закрытия сокращено с 9.10 с до 1.91 с.

# Oblivion for Android 0.1.3

APK: `Oblivion-0.1.3.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).
SHA-1 `e74c55c378825480eedb6b2c781946bc4bef3555`

## Fixed
- Mali GPUs: geometry no longer explodes into streaks on Mali GPUs (Exynos, Dimensity, Tensor, Kirin), which lack the clip-distance feature.

## Performance
- Each thread keeps its own cache of recently freed small blocks and reuses them without taking the global heap lock. In testing, an allocate-and-free went from about 34 ms to 5 ms. Freeing the same block twice is still detected and logged though.
- A thread that re-enters a lock it already holds now just counts up the way Windows does, instead of going through the real lock each time.
- Memory copies: the base memcpy routine, about 10% of all CPU, now runs as Android's native copy.
- The game reads the clock hundreds of thousands of times a second. QueryPerformanceCounter, GetTickCount and timeGetTime now read the processor's hardware timer instead of making a system call.
- A missing Data folder is now remembered after the first check - no repeated path search and log line each time.

Please attach `port/log.txt` from your Oblivion folder to any bug report.

## NHL Legacy 2027 — 1.0.3

Выбранный в лаунчере язык RU/EN теперь используется на экране подготовки графики и в Android-настройках во время игры: меню Select, настройках кнопок, окне назначения и режиме перемещения кнопок. Лаунчер переключается сразу, внутриигровые экраны — при следующем запуске игры. Язык оригинального игрового интерфейса выбирается отдельно.

The launcher’s RU/EN choice now carries into graphics preparation and in-game Android controls: the Select menu, game settings, button mapping, and button-layout editor. The launcher updates immediately; in-game Android screens use the choice on the next game launch. The original game language remains separate.

Signed Android ARM64 APK, `versionCode 14`, same package and signing certificate as 1.0.2. Native libraries, game assets, and the ISO importer are unchanged byte for byte. The Y700 installed this version over 1.0.2 without deleting imported game files. Device checks confirmed the graphics-preparation screen and game settings in both EN and RU, the English button-mapping and layout screens, and both Select-menu languages. A match was not replayed for this text-only update.

releases.name: WinLite v1.4.0
releases.body:
# WinLite v1.4.0

## Overview
A release focused on rendering smoothness, a new X11 server and Steam support.

---

## 🎮 BETA - Steam
- Steam client support added.

---

## 🖥️ X11 server (rewritten in Rust)
The built-in X server has been rewritten from scratch in Rust and now covers much more of the X11 protocol.

**What you get**
- **Stability.** Memory-safe code removes a whole class of crashes and hangs.
- **Better game and launcher compatibility.** Newer screen-configuration (RANDR 1.2) and rendering extensions are supported, so Wine, launchers and games see a more complete environment.
- **Proper mouse cursors.** System cursors are drawn from a built-in cursor set, and colored/semi-transparent and animated cursors are supported.
- **Better frame pacing.** Frame presentation is synchronized with the real display refresh rate and with fences, which gives the renderer and the FPS limiter an accurate clock to work from.
- **Faster window drawing.** The shared frame buffer is locked once per operation instead of repeatedly, and more drawing requests (lines, rectangles, area clears) are handled directly.

Title: v2.6 – Xbox 360 games through Xenia, Xbox and Xenia settings tabs
Repository description:
Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu (original Xbox emulator) with a console-style dashboard, Xbox 360 games through your own Xenia, one-click 60 FPS patches, upscaling filters, CPU/GPU boost with per-game settings, and tools for finding out why a game is slow. Not supported by the xemu project.
---
Release body (paste into the GitHub release):
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.

What's new in v2.6
Xbox 360 games, through your own Xenia. xemu does not emulate the Xbox 360, and this fork still doesn't include or change any 360 emulator. If you download Xenia or Xenia Canary yourself, the library can now list your 360 games and start them in it.
Turn on Show Xbox 360 games on the new Xenia tab and choose your `xenia.exe` / `xenia_canary.exe`. Your game folders are scanned for disc images (.iso), extracted games with a `default.xex`, .xex files, Games on Demand and Xbox Live Arcade packages.

releases.name: v2.5 – Tron Red theme, sphere emblem, holographic covers, DOA3 color fix, Linux AppImage
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.

What's new in v2.5

Tron Red. A third dashboard color next to Neon and Green, red with amber. It works on every dashboard style. Pick it under Settings > Dashboard theme or the Library menu.
Sphere and fins is the default dashboard, with an X emblem on the sphere. New installs start on Original Blades in the original green. The sphere, fins, web, orbs and bars take the theme color you choose (cyan for Neon, red and orange for Tron Red), and so does the emblem. If you already picked a style or theme, nothing changes for you.
Holo and Aurora dashboards. Two more styles. Holo is a hologram terminal, and now has a light-cycle fight in its arena: two cycles meet, one is wounded and breaks into cubes of light, the other runs on and a new pair appears.
Holographic covers. Settings > Home screen covers has a third choice, Holographic: cases float over a projector ring, bob and turn slowly, with scanlines, a sweep of light, an occasional glitch and a tint in your theme color.

releases.name: v2.4 – Faster library scanning, Clear library, version in the title bar
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.4
Version in the title bar. The window now reads "xemu Modern GUI v2.4 | xemu v0.8.139", so it's easy to tell which build you're running.
Faster library scanning. Games appear as soon as they're found instead of after the whole folder has been read, several disc images are read at once, and extracted game folders (any folder containing `default.xbe`) are no longer searched file by file. Recycle-bin and hidden folders are skipped.
Clear library. Library > Folders has a new "Clear library..." button. It empties the game list and forgets your game folders, individually added games and hidden games, so you can add them again from scratch. Your game files are never touched. Play time, favorites, custom names and per-game settings are kept.

1.4 GHz CPU option. Real hardware speed can pace to 733 MHz (stock) or 1.4 GHz (like a modded console), under Settings > Performance. Real hardware speed is off by default.

releases.name: v2.3 – Faster games, NFL Fever 2004 fix, Linux build, Performance and compatibility release: CPU boost, GPU boost, per-game settings with automatic safe mode, a fix that lets NFL Fever 2004 run, and a first Linux build
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.3
This release is about speed and game compatibility. The emulation changes are listed here so you know what touches the game itself.
CPU boost and GPU boost (Settings > General > Performance). CPU boost runs the game's SSE math on your PC's processor and trims work in the CPU emulation. GPU boost turns on faster paths in the graphics code, such as skipping textures a shader never reads. Turn either off if a game misbehaves. The ideas and some of the code come from Tovarichtch's xemu fork (branch `perf-experimental`).
Per-game settings and safe mode. Each game can have its own CPU boost, GPU boost and shader seeding, used the next time it starts (Settings > General > Performance > This game). If xemu closes unexpectedly while a boost was on, that game starts in safe mode the next time, with the boosts off, and tells you. "Leave safe mode" is in the same place.

releases.body:
天玑 / MediaTek X11 专版 · 合成器测试版

本版基于 1.2.0 天玑 X11 分支，**唯一改动是打开 KWin 合成器**，用于真机验证桌面特效（窗口晃动、魔灯等）能否真正生效。

#### 本版改了什么

此前每次启动桌面会话时，脚本都会把 `kwinrc` 强制改写为：

```ini
[Compositing]
Enabled=false
Backend=QPainter
```

这正是「在系统设置里勾了窗口晃动 / 魔灯，晃了半天毫无反应」的直接原因——**合成器关着，KWin 会静默忽略全部桌面特效**。

本版改为：

```ini
[Compositing]
Enabled=true
Backend=OpenGL
GLCore=false
LatencyPolicy=Low
WindowsBlockCompositing=false
```

后端固定为 **OpenGL（硬件）**，不使用纯软件 QPainter 后端；LLVM 软件渲染（llvmpipe / swrast）在部署时仍会被删除。

#### ⚠️ 这是未经验证的测试版，请只用于测试

发布者手上没有天玑真机，**本版没有在任何天玑设备上跑过**。请把预期放低。

已知的关键疑点（在我的机器上实测发现，属于**设备无关**的问题）：

1. **guest rootfs 内缺少 `virpipe_dri.so`**。逐个列出 rootfs 中全部 Mesa DRI 驱动后确认：有 `virtio_gpu_dri.so`、`zink_dri.so`、`panfrost_dri.so`、`mediatek_dri.so`，**但没有 `virpipe_dri.so`**——而这正是 VirGL 的 guest 端驱动。会话脚本仍在强制 `GALLIUM_DRIVER=virpipe` + `VTEST_SOCKET=/tmp/.virgl_test`，即**指向一个不存在的驱动**。若真机因此拿不到 GL 上下文，合成器就起不来。
2. **相反方向的证据**：发布者在高通测试机上开启 OpenGL 合成后桌面全黑，日志为 `MESA: error: ZINK: vkGetCalibratedTimestampsEXT failed (VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY)`。但那条日志同时说明 **KWin 当时确实拿到了 GL 上下文**（走的是 Zink）。这与第 1 点互相矛盾，怀疑 KWin 走 EGL 入口、Qt 走 GLX 入口，两者对 `GALLIUM_DRIVER` 的处理不同。

releases.name: v0.10.77 — Lower CPU use during races on Android
releases.body:
## Changes

- **Lower CPU use during races on Android.** A check the game makes very often (whenever two game threads coordinate) now skips work it had already done, so races need less of the phone's CPU. This is aimed at slower phones such as the Pixel 10a, where the CPU is the limit. On the AYN Thor the game used about 15–20% less CPU time in the middle of a race. The picture and the race are unchanged. For #176

## Validation

- **CPU time on the AYN Thor** (the middle of a Dolphin Resort race, CPU seconds the game used per second): 1.81 against 2.19 in 0.10.76 for a normal race, 1.78 against 2.18 with touch and tilt, 1.81 against 2.18 with camera motion, 2.51 against 3.15 at Race step rate 120, 1.87 against 2.20 with CPU difficulty Hard.
- **The rest, as in 0.10.76:**
  - **Windows x64 package:**
    - A whole Dolphin Resort race on Vulkan with the validation layer: no errors, full speed (1.000).
    - The title movie, Sharp scaling and an Avatar award in the middle of a race.
    - Direct3D 11 (experimental) at feature levels 11.1 and 11.0.
    - The copy without AVX: full speed, and no AVX instructions outside Microsoft's C runtime.

releases.name: v0.10.76 — Less work per draw on the main thread
releases.body:
## Changes

- **Less CPU time spent drawing each race frame.** The game's main thread now finds textures and sets them up for drawing with much less work, so busy frames with many objects on screen are less likely to run late, especially on phones that slow down when they get hot. On the AYN Thor, drawing a race frame takes about 0.7 ms less (about a fifth less per object drawn). The picture is unchanged. For #176

## Validation

- **Drawing time on the AYN Thor** (frame timing on, the middle of a Dolphin Resort race): 2.8 ms of drawing a frame and 3.1 µs per object, against 3.4–3.7 ms and 4.0–4.1 µs in 0.10.75; texture work went from about 1.0 ms to 0.3 ms a frame.
- **The picture is unchanged on Windows:** the same Windows checks as 0.10.75 all passed (see below), and while PR #454 was tested, the new code drew the same 27 pictures bit for bit as 0.10.75 from the title screen up to the race (races themselves never repeat exactly, so they were compared by eye).
- **The rest, as in 0.10.75:**
  - **Windows x64 package:**
    - A whole Dolphin Resort race on Vulkan with the validation layer: no errors, full speed (1.000).

releases.body:
**Nixport v1.2.304-alpha** — a test build for people who want to try it early.

> Published by hand: built and signed with the same key as v1.1.299-alpha and
> v1.0.267-alpha (upgrades install over them without uninstalling).

## Changelog (since v1.1.299-alpha)

### Gamepads

- **Single-player pad model** (replaces v1.1's player slots): exactly one physical
  pad feeds the game at a time. The pad you touch takes over automatically
  (last-active wins); the session drawer offers "use this pad" to pin a choice for
  the session. The effective pad and the on-screen controls merge into one player.
- **Fix: intermittent directional input**. After opening a menu or losing focus,
  sticks / D-pad / triggers now reach the game immediately at their current position —
  no more "only X works in the load screen" or "the first press does nothing".
  The old "stay blocked until centered" gate is gone (keys only).
- Rumble now always lands on the effective pad (Xbox-protocol pads don't expose
  motors to Android — enable "phone vibration" as the fallback).
- On-screen stale-state fix: a closed overlay can no longer pin the virtual stick
  over the physical one.
